cohort: The study included 245 asymptomatic pregnant women in Libreville, Gabon, who were not previously known diabetics.
finding: The study found a GDM prevalence of 10.2% (WHO 1999) and 4.5% (WHO 2013) among asymptomatic pregnant women in Libreville, with high maternal weight, overweight at recruitment, personal history of GDM, and age combined with high parity identified as associated factors.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was identified as an outcome of GDM.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy, regardless of the stage of pregnancy at the moment of recruitment
